# Ultrasonic Distance Detector with LED    Alert&nbsp;

&nbsp;

&nbsp;

# Aim:

To interface an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor with an Arduino Uno to detect nearby objects and trigger an LED indicator based on distance.

## Component:

![][image1]
![image1](componentultraled.jpeg)
&nbsp;

&nbsp;

### **Working:**

### The Arduino Uno initiates the process by sending a high-frequency trigger pulse to the HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, causing its transmitter to emit sound waves into the surrounding environment. When these sound waves encounter an obstacle, they bounce back as an echo and are captured by the sensor's receiver module. The Arduino measures the exact time interval between sending the trigger and receiving the echo signal, then uses the constant speed of sound to compute the obstacle's distance. Finally, the microcontroller evaluates this measured value against a pre-programmed threshold limit, instantly turning on the LED indicator to signal a warning whenever an object enters the close-range zone.

##### SCHEMATIC DIAGRAM:

#### ![][image3]
![image3](schematicdiagramultraled.jpeg)
CODE:

&nbsp;

const int trigPin \= 9;

const int echoPin \= 10;

const int ledPin \= 13;

&nbsp;

long duration;

float distance;

&nbsp;

void setup() {

&nbsp;&nbsp;pinMode(trigPin, OUTPUT);

&nbsp;&nbsp;pinMode(echoPin, INPUT);

&nbsp;&nbsp;pinMode(ledPin, OUTPUT);

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;Serial.begin(9600);

}

&nbsp;

void loop() {

&nbsp;&nbsp;// Send ultrasonic pulse

&nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);

&nbsp;&nbsp;delayMicroseconds(2);

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(trigPin, HIGH);

&nbsp;&nbsp;delayMicroseconds(10);

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;// Measure the echo time

&nbsp;&nbsp;duration \= pulseIn(echoPin, HIGH);

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;// Calculate distance in cm

&nbsp;&nbsp;distance \= duration \* 0.0343 / 2;

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;Serial.print("Distance: ");

&nbsp;&nbsp;Serial.print(distance);

&nbsp;&nbsp;Serial.println(" cm");

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;// Turn LED ON if an object is within 10 cm

&nbsp;&nbsp;if (distance \<= 10 && distance \> 0\) {

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(ledPin, HIGH);

&nbsp;&nbsp;}&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;else {

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(ledPin, LOW);

&nbsp;&nbsp;}

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;delay(100);

}

&nbsp;

**Applications:**

* Automotive reverse-parking sensor systems to prevent collisions.  
* Obstacle avoidance systems for autonomous robots and drones.  
* Non-contact liquid level monitoring in tanks and reservoirs.  
* Smart security barriers and automated intrusion detection systems.

&nbsp;

RESULT:

&nbsp;

The system successfully measures object distance using ultrasonic waves and provides a visual alert via the LED whenever an obstacle is detected within range.&nbsp;
